overall: The AG found the School Committee and Screening Committee violated the OML by late response to a minutes request and the Screening Committee by not filing certifications; no violation for the forum, and no intent finding.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Committees failed to timely provide meeting minutes and documents used at meetings, after a March 27 records request.
allegations.key_passage: As the Committees concede, they failed to timely respond to the Complainant’s request in violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged Screening Committee members never signed Open Meeting Law certification forms upon appointment or afterward.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that the Screening Committee violated the Open Meeting Law in this regard.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Screening Committee held meetings, including the February 15 community forum, for which notice was not posted.
allegations.key_passage: Since the Forum did not include any deliberation by members of the Screening Committee, it was not a “meeting” for the purposes of the Open Meeting Law and therefore did not need to be posted in accordance with the provisions of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant urged that the violations were intentional, citing prior determinations against the School Committee.
allegations.key_passage: Here, because Mr. Markham and Mr. Tiro promptly acknowledged receipt of the Complainant’s request and asked for a short extension of time in good faith, which the Complainant refused, we decline to find that the violations were intentional.

allegations.summary: In the request for further review, complainant alleged the open session minutes, once produced, were insufficiently detailed.
allegations.key_passage: However, we decline to review this allegation because it was not included within the original complaint to the public body.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law by the School Committee.
All School Committee members to file certifications of receipt of Open Meeting Law materials with the Wakefield Town Clerk within 30 days of the determination.
remedy_passage: We also order all members of the School Committee to file with the Wakefield Town Clerk, within 30 days following receipt of this determination.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
